Dates.text: Yuri Gagarin is born in the village of Klushino.
Vostok 1 launches from Baikonur; Gagarin orbits Earth once in 108 minutes.
Gagarin dies in a training flight crash.

Title: Gagarin, first human in space
Body-Text: Born in the village of Klushino, Yuri Gagarin worked as a foundryman at a steel plant before he learned to fly. On 12 April 1961 he launched from the Baikonur Cosmodrome aboard Vostok 1 and completed one orbit of Earth in 108 minutes, becoming the first human to leave our planet.
